question: Can one continuously writable 20-node circuit act on the value of another experience, use the actual result, and retain earlier learning abilities?
starting_points: Use the established original and independent six-birth cohorts from the previous study. Every help, forced branch or privileged readout must be identified. The living network receives ordinary sensory input, its own movement, and physically obtained taste. Outer optimization may use realized outcomes.
primary_tracks: Choose between two visible study objects within a finite review budget, against equal-opportunity random and external uncertainty baselines.
Decide whether to buy an informative contact after a matched history with or without useful evidence, with an independently randomized publicly posted cost.
Measure the value of individual review decisions by intervening from the same held state, and test ordinary short and longer mixed abilities on each resulting graph.
quality: Pair outcomes within independent births and scene geometries. Preserve shared worlds across arms, reserve new worlds and the second cohort, report choices, resource costs and motor outcomes with explicit denominators. Retain failures and final inference checkpoints.
operations: Local experiments only. Stop launching training early enough to verify final stages and finish by noon.
